note: The shared CSV export hits the 1,048,575-row Excel limit, so this is 584,524 non-empty order lines out of the ~1M the Kaggle page advertises. State this in the report; do not claim "half a million" as the whole file.

sku_level.warning: SKU-level forecasting on this dataset covers only a minority of volume. Report it as a secondary analysis, not the headline claim.

seasonality.reading: A November ratio well above 1 is the Black Friday effect. Ramadan does not show up cleanly in this export, which is itself a finding: do not assume the festival effect is large in this marketplace without measuring it.
